# Complete claim index

This is navigation only. Read each full disposition, source binding and original locator.

## boundary-native

The complete native pathway has NAD-KIN-RXN, RXN-5822 and TRANS-RXN0-277, not a two-event kinase/phosphatase-only record.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: /ptools-xml/Pathway/reaction-list and reaction-layout

## boundary-pathbank

Frozen PW002081 contains two BiochemicalReaction nodes and one TransportWithBiochemicalReaction, all attached to SMP0002093. The screening count of 2 is class-specific, not a missing third event.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: /rdf:RDF/bp:Pathway/bp:pathwayComponent; bp:TransportWithBiochemicalReaction[@rdf:ID="ReactionCoupledTransports/189"]

## core-nadk

NadK catalyzes ATP-dependent oxidation-state-preserving NAD phosphorylation; exact Rhea18630 five sides.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: /ptools-xml/Reaction/{left,right,dblink,reaction-direction}

## core-phosphatase

Rhea28051 hydrolyzes NADP to NAD plus hydrogenphosphate, consuming water.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: /ptools-xml/Reaction/{left,right,dblink,reaction-direction}

## core-pnt

Rhea47994 consumes NADH,NADP and one proton outside, producing NAD,NADPH and one proton inside.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: /ptools-xml/Reaction/{left,right} with compartment tags

## frozen-proton-conflict

PathBank transport assigns both proton sides to the same Inner_Membrane entity; preserve frozen source as coarse structural context.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: bp:TransportWithBiochemicalReaction/bp:left and bp:right

## nadk-assembly

Native NadK complex CPLX0-682 has six MONOMER0-541 chains, corroborated by purified approximately180kDa/30kDa measurements.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: /ptools-xml/Protein/component/coefficient

## nadk-sequence

Native purified NadK N-terminal MDNHFKCIGI differs at residue2 from predicted MNNHFKCIGI; do not equate exact preparation to current reference sequence.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results Identification of yfjB and N-terminal sequence

## nadk-construct

Recombinant pSK67 uses yfjB in pET14b NcoI/BamHI, BL21(DE3)pLysS; empty SK45 negative control. Vector name alone does not prove a retained His tag.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Materials and methods Construction/purification and Results Identification

## nadk-donor

NadK supports ATP,UTP,CTP,GTP,dATP,TTP donor assays with reported relative activities100,109,60,56,42,40.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Table2

## nadk-donor-negative

Polyphosphate,ADP,AMP,glucose6P and p-nitrophenylphosphate did not support the measured NadK phosphorylation.

Disposition: negative context, not inhibitory edges

Locator: Table2 and donor specificity text

## nadk-metal

Replacing Mg with Mn,Zn,Ca or Co supports NadK at1mM; reported relative100,242,104,85,73%.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Table4

## nadk-metal-negative

Fe,Cu,Na,K,Li and omission of metal gave no detected NadK activity in the replacement assay.

Disposition: negative cofactor-substitution context

Locator: Table4

## nadk-redox-inhibitors

NADH and NADPH inhibit E.coli NadK in vitro in2001 and1987; native REG0-7644/7643 retain allosteric negative signs.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: PDF pages2–4 Figures1–3/Table2

## nadk-nadp-conflict

1987 describes no significant NADP effect at tested conditions;2001 finds slight inhibition at50–100µM.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Table5; contrast PMID3025169 Table2

## nadk-thiol

PCMB and HgCl2 inhibit NadK, whereas tested DTT,2-mercaptoethanol and glutathione do not affect it.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Table5 and Results effectors

## nadk-energy-negative

Adenylate energy charge variation did not alter the1987 NadK rate, with or without NADPH.

Disposition: negative context

Locator: PDF page3 Effect of adenylate energy charge

## nadk-km-conflict

The1987 abstract and Results reverse the1.9/2.1mM NAD/ATP Km assignment.

Disposition: retain internal numerical discrepancy; no single unqualified number

Locator: PDF page1 abstract versus page2 Results

## phoa-assay

Purified E.coli alkaline phosphatase converted historical TPN to DPN.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results Compounds Tested as Substrates, printedpage842

## phoa-periplasm

PhoA is a secreted/periplasmic homodimer, not proof of a cytosolic NADP recycling loop.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: comments SUBUNIT/SUBCELLULAR LOCATION; features signal/chain

## phoa-metal

PhoA binds two zinc and one magnesium ions per subunit according to issuing reviewed annotation.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: comments COFACTOR; binding features

## phoa-broad-inhibitors

1962 broad-substrate PhoA inhibitor and activation assays used pNPP/AMP contexts; they are not NADP-specific inhibition experiments.

Disposition: source-qualified enzyme context

Locator: TablesII–III and Discussion

## unknown-phosphatase

Native NADPPHOSPHAT-MONOMER is an unnamed/gene-unassigned hypothetical physiological activity; it cannot be silently assigned to CysQ.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: whole Protein and NADPPHOSPHAT-ENZRXN evidence

## cysq-construct

The2007 E.coli CysQ assay used ASKA AG1 pCA24N with N-terminal His6+TDPALRA and C-terminal GLCGR extensions, GFP removed.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: PDF pages1–2 Materials and methods

## cysq-nadpase

Purified tagged CysQ hydrolyzed NADP and NADPH at pH8,37C,10mM Mg; both rate and substrate scope remain in vitro.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: PDF pages3–4 Table2/Results

## cysq-negative

CysQ NADPase was undetectable at pH6.4 or0.2mM Mg; SuhB/Fbp extracts were negative controls.

Disposition: explicit condition/negative context

Locator: PDF pages3–5 Results

## cysq-lithium

LiCl inhibited CysQ with substrate-dependent IC50: NADP70mM,NADPH60mM,FBP10mM,3-PAP0.05mM,2-PAP0.15mM.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: PDF page4 Table3

## cysq-physiological-limit

Authors concluded CysQ probably is not the physiological E.coli NADP phosphatase; PAP specificity/conditions favored another role.

Disposition: mandatory limit on catalytic assignment

Locator: PDF page5 Discussion

## cysq-archaea

MJ0109/AF2372/MJ0917 activities in archaeal preparations remain separate organism/temperature/construct comparisons.

Disposition: comparison queue; not E.coli catalyst identity

Locator: PDF pages2–5 and Table2

## pnt-assembly

Native PntAB has two PntA plus two PntB chains;2021 describes a dimer of heterodimers.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: /ptools-xml/Protein/component

## pnt-localization

PntAB is inner-membrane proton-coupled; nucleotide binding domains face the cytoplasm.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Introduction and Fig1; Results and Methods orientation

## pnt-construct2021

2021 PntAB construct is N-terminal alpha His6 with thrombin site, expressed in THOC43(DE3)ΔcyoΔpntAB; do not assume tag removal.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Methods Protein expression and purification

## pnt-proton-controls

Reverse PntAB hydride transfer builds a proton gradient and supports co-reconstituted ATP synthase; betaH91A/noenzyme/ionophore controls test coupling.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results Figs2–4 and Methods

## pnt-pmf

ATP-synthase-generated pmf stimulated forward PntAB NADPH formation in reconstituted proteoliposomes.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results Fig4

## pnt-surrogates

APAD was used for reverse/cyclic and orientation readouts; natural NAD(H)/NADP(H) assays are separate.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Methods Activity assays and orientation

## pnt-inhibitors

Native annotations report inhibition by dicyclohexylcarbodiimide and irreversible NBDchloride inhibition.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: whole Regulation; REG0-9666; corresponding compound originals

## pnt-physiology2004

MG1655 deletion/13C balance supports35–45% anabolic NADPH contribution by PntAB during aerobic glucose growth.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: PDF pages2–6 Results/Tables

## stha-physiology2004

SthA/UdhA was needed for growth on acetate and in the NADPH-overproducing pgi background, while standard glucose growth showed little requirement.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results Tables1–4 and deletion/rescue text

## transcript-model-conflict

2004 expression/redox interpretation was a hypothesis;2016 reporter data did not support direct NAD(P)H-pool-dependent transcription of either enzyme.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results Figs1–3; Discussion

## paraquat-negative

10µM paraquat did not induce pntAB/udhA reporter activity; zwf served as oxidative-stress response comparison.

Disposition: negative conditional context

Locator: Results Fig3

## reg2016-construct

BW25113 Keio mutants carry low-copy whole-intergenic GFPmut2 reporters with50–100bp flanks, M9 5g/L carbon37C mid-exponential.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Methods and supplement TableS1

## reg2016-ihf

Deletion of IHF A substantially lowers pntAB reporter under succinate,glycerol,glucose; the tested deletion is the alpha subunit.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: TableS3 PDFpage10, IHF A row

## reg2016-lrp

Lrp loss reduces pntAB and raises udhA with carbon-dependent magnitudes; amino-acid mixture removes much of that effect.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: TableS3 pages10/12 and TableS4 pages15/17

## reg2016-argp-fur

ArgP loss reduces pntAB on glucose, Fur loss on succinate; both are conditional reporter effects, not demonstrated promoter binding.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: TableS3 PDFpage9 ArgP/Fur rows

## reg2016-arca

ArcA loss raises udhA on glucose; the2016 aerobic conditions do not reproduce2014 anaerobic pntAB activation.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: TableS3 PDFpages9/11 ArcA rows; TableS4 page16

## reg2016-hns-crp

With20-amino-acid mixture H-NS and CRP deletions raise pntAB reporter; without mixture the measured effects differ.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: TableS4 pages14/15 versus TableS3 pages9/10

## reg2016-effectors

Leucine lowered pntAB and raised udhA reporters; lysine/histidine lowered pntAB; methionine raised udhA.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results Figure6/individual amino acids

## reg2016-camp

Extracellular cAMP activates the CRP reporter and lowers normalized pntAB reporter, with only marginal udhA reduction.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results Figure7 and Methods normalization

## reg2016-tyrr

TableS4 TyrR deletion has udhA332.83 versusWT801.20 under amino-acid mixture, a supported additional screen observation.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: PDFpages16/18 TableS4 WT/TyrR rows

## reg2016-all-controls

All62 TF-screen rows and their growth rates/deviations are retained; below-threshold changes are not proof of no biology.

Disposition: complete screen context retained, not62 invented direct edges

Locator: TablesS2–S4 PDFpages7–18

## reg2014-arca

ArcA binding+expression gives pntAB activation and sthA repression under anaerobic glucose fermentation and nitrate respiration.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results section2/3; Methods strains; S1/S2 exact rows

## reg2019-lrp

Native2019 curated joins assign Lrp activation of phoA in MIN transition and pntA in MIN log, repression of sthA in MIN log.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Regulation and REG0-15529/REG0-15570

## reg2017-nac

Nac induced-FLAG ChIP+RNA has pntA peak1675942,45coverage,−15bp and publishedFC0.372191.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Methods2/1,2/2,2/4,2/6; supplementalMOESM3 Nac Binding and RNA-Seq row238

## reg2017-csir-context

CsiR induced RNA-seq has pntAFC2.793539 but it is absent from its bound-target sheet.

Disposition: retain expression-only contextual observation

Locator: MOESM2 All CsiR RNA-Seq row2451 versus CsiR Binding and RNA-Seq entire sheet

## reg-phob

Phosphorylated PhoB activates phoA in the native promoter/regulation join; acidic/aerobic context differs from microaerobic.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Regulation + PM00071/TU00052

## reg-phosphate2019

2019 phosphate-starvation measurements use MG1655 promoter fragments fused to BCD2/msfgfp in DH10B pSEVA plasmids; syntheticPliar experiments and model rates are distinct.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Methods paragraphs13–14; ResultsFig2 versusFig5

## reg-spot42

Spot42 overexpression reduces sthA transcript and translational-fusion output; regionIII mutation and compensatory target mutation support base pairing.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results Spot42 repression and base-pairing; Figs1–3

## reg-spot42-followup

2012 analysis supports multiple Spot42 pairing regions for sthA but simultaneous binding/stoichiometry remains unresolved.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results multi-site pairing Fig3; Discussion paragraph5

## stha-assembly

Native UDHA-CPLX octamer matches2022 size estimates;1999 reported7–8 subunits remains older abstract/native context.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Protein/component

## stha-construct2022

2022 SthA is C-terminalHis10 E.coliK12 reference cloned in pBXC3H and expressed in MC1061; FAD supplemented duringlysis.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Methods gene cloning/expression/protein purification

## stha-surrogate

2022 transhydrogenation kinetic assay uses NADH and thioNADP;2004 crudeextract reverse assay uses APAD.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results transhydrogenation; Methods assays

## stha-fad

SthA tightly binds FAD, with partial SEC cofactor loss;2022 C45A/T50C variants lose moreFAD and have lower transfer activity.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results FAD binding/variants; supplementS1,S8

## stha-adenylates

AMP,ADP,ATP at5mM increased WT SthA surrogate transhydrogenation; ADP gave the largest response.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results adenine nucleotides; supplementTable1 exactWT andvariantrows

## stha-phosphate

Phosphate inhibits the2022 SthA surrogate assay;NaCl/KClcontrols did not at<=50mM but high500mM salt loweredactivity.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results inhibition; supplementS4

## stha-substrate-inhib

HighNADH and thioNADP inhibited the2022 surrogate assay;2011nativeannotationNADPHsubstrateinhibition is anotherdirection.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results kinetics; nativeUDHA annotationPMID21545646

## stha-oxidase

SthA oxidizes NADH/NADPH with oxygen, releasingH2O2and superoxide in uncoupled assays; oxygen omission prevents repeatedflavinreoxidation.

Disposition: include with the stated scope

Locator: Results oxidase andanaerobiccontrols; supplementS5/S6/S9

## stha-nocausal-oxyr

The12nt sthA/oxyR overlap motivated a redox-stresshypothesis, not a demonstrated OxyR→sthA regulatoryedge.

Disposition: hypothesis/context only

Locator: Discussion; supplementS10

## stha-model-id

Paper lists referenceP27306 but AlphaFoldAF-B7M718-F1; do not claim exact experimental structure of the reference chain.

Disposition: model/reference distinction; no experimental structureidentity claim

Locator: Dataavailability/structuralmodel Methods

## imodulon

iModulonDB exactgene queries and10selectedmodules provide computational context only.

Disposition: noncausal computational context

Locator: queries, summaries and raw gene tables

## nadk-2005-variants

UniProtP0A7B3 documents R175G/H/Q/T gaining NADH kinase activity, unlikeR175E/I/K;R175G lowersNADkinaseVmax.

Disposition: include qualified context

Locator: features Mutagenesis position175

## stha-2011-metals

2011 fusedEcSTH abstract reports adenylate stimulation and inhibition byMn/Co/Zn/Ni/Cu;after30minpreincubation most effectswane exceptZn/Ni/Cu.

Disposition: include qualified context

Locator: resultList.result[id=21545646].abstractText

## pnt-dccd-details

DCCD inhibition/protonpumping observations include NADHprotection andNADP/NADPHenhancement;1993D232/E238/E240triplemutants retainpumping andbecomelessDCCD-sensitive.

Disposition: include qualified context

Locator: PMID3891338 and8100227 abstractText

## pnt-nbd-details

NBDchloride modifiesbetaC147/C260andotherresidues;NADPHprotectssomedomainsbutreactiveNBD-NADPHadductisalsoan inhibitor.

Disposition: include qualified context

Locator: PMID10556628 abstractText

## stha-historical-sequence

1999 cloning corrected an N-terminal genome sequencing error and identified soluble UdhA;currentreference chain is sequence-grounded separately.

Disposition: include qualified context

Locator: PMID9922271 abstractText

## stha-supporting-event

SthA natural redox reaction is Rhea11693 NAD+NADPH→NADH+NADP, without proton transport, supported by issuingP27306.

Disposition: include qualified context

Locator: comments CATALYTIC ACTIVITY/physiologicalReactions

## frozen-chemical-forms

PathBanklinksNAD15846/NADH16908/NADP18009/NADPH16474/ATP15422/ADP16761/Pi18367; exactRheausesdifferent chargeforms.

Disposition: include qualified context

Locator: SmallMoleculeReference/xref toChEBI unificationobjects

## historical-turnover

1971/1973 pyridine nucleotide metabolism papers cited forphysiologicaldephosphorylation were notaccessible asfulltext orabstract.

Disposition: include qualified context

Locator: PMID5543676 and4146187 metadata

## phoa-processing

PhoA signalpeptide andN-terminalArg processingisozymes are reviewedsourcecontext;DsbA-assistedfolding/Iapprocessingare notNADPsubstrate-specificregulation.

Disposition: include qualified context

Locator: comments PTM/SUBUNIT/SUBCELLULAR LOCATION andfeatures

## reg2017-nac-cysq

The Nac bound-target sheet also contains cysQ: peak4434633,coverage22,−145bp, published inductionFC2.176844. Preserve this positive conditional expression/binding context for the assayed CysQ reference protein.

Disposition: include condition-qualified regulation or explicit contextual disposition

Locator: Nac Binding and RNA-Seq!A62:K62

## reg2017-expression-screen-complete

All sixteen selected-gene rows are retained. CsiR pntA and pntB have opposite measured fold-change signs; neither is in its bound-target sheet. Other target rows retain values without invented statistical significance.

Disposition: complete quantitative context, no blanket promoter-binding edges

Locator: all sixteen rows with exact workbook/sheet/row bindings
